messages:
Nora (PM): Dropping a quick review thread for the new compare table iteration. Main asks: reduce column density on ~1024px widths, clarify what the performance badges mean (latency vs throughput), and decide pin scope wording. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/example-compare

Diego (Design): Looked through it. Table compresses awkwardly between 980-1200px. Suggest collapsing the tags and guidance columns into an expandable row on narrower screens. For badges: add an icon + label (e.g., ⚡ P95 120ms) and avoid color-only meaning. Also add a small microtrend arrow to signal regressions.

Rae (Eng): Implementation notes: our current pin object stores alias not immutable version_id; that causes pins to shift during alias rollouts. We should store model_version_id for pins. Also we have to decide on pin scope: user vs workspace. Tech effort: personal pins are trivial; workspace pins require auth checks and audit logs.

Sam (Research): From user testing: people expect the pinned model to persist even when they change filters. If it's hidden by filters they want a quick way to reveal it. Recommended UX: show pinned model at top with subtle grey if excluded and banner 'Pinned model hidden by active filters' + 'Show pinned' action.

A11y-Bot: Automated scan: contrast issues on pale red/orange badge fills at low opacity. Recommend dark text label and accessible icon. Table headers lack aria-sort attributes; rows missing aria-rowindex. Action buttons must be reachable with keyboard; consider roving tabindex for row actions.

Diego (Design): Copy proposals: change "Pin model" to "Set default compare model". In modal provide a small scope selector: radio choices 'Only me' (default) and 'Workspace'. If workspace selected show confirmation text: 'This will set the default for everyone in your workspace.' Tooltip on pin: 'Pinned v2 — used as default compare'. For excluded pins microcopy: 'Pinned model hidden by current filters. Show anyway.'

Rae (Eng): Proposed API example (for discussion): {"action":"set_pin","model_version_id":"mv-1234","scope":"user","actor":"user-9"}. We'll emit event pin.changed and pin.invalidate.<org> when workspace pins change. Migration: for existing pins that reference alias we'll backfill version_id where possible and mark ambiguous pins for manual review.

Nora (PM): Decisions and next steps: 1) Store immutable model_version_id for pins (Rae to implement migration + API change) 2) Ship personal pins first; include workspace pin UX but gated behind backend support — prefer to surface scope selector but disable workspace option until backend ready (Diego to mock disabled state). 3) Replace color-only badges with icon+label and aria-labels (Diego + Sam). 4) Show pinned model at top when filtered out with greyed row + banner 'Show pinned'. 5) Accessibility checklist: add aria-sort, aria-rowindex, keyboard access to row actions (Rae + A11y-Bot to verify).

Diego (Design): I'll update Figma with compact collapse behavior, disabled workspace pin state, badge styling, and banner copy. Target: Wed EOD.

Rae (Eng): I'll open a small PR for schema change and post migration notes by Thu. Will also add the event hooks for cache invalidation.

Sam (Research): I'll capture microcopy variants and run two quick remote tests for discoverability of 'Show pinned' by Fri.

Nora (PM): Thanks all — scheduling a 25-min follow-up Fri 10:30 to verify Figma + API draft. :calendar:
